static_traits.name: Gao Rui
static_traits.family_status: Orphaned since childhood, with no existing family members
static_traits.social_status: Weak social support, but has one close friend who can offer support when needed; often feeling out of place in Social situations
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no psychotherapy received before or counseling
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, coherent logic, able to describe emotions and distress concretely; high cooperation; emotions showing Anxiety and hope coexisting

basic_info.main_problem: Due to being raised as an orphan, I feel I will most likely never have a family of my own, which makes me feel Loneliness and despair long-term and affects my building deep relationships with others.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because the sense of Loneliness is affecting my daily life and mental health. I hope that if I can change my thinking and believe I can build connections, I can reduce the Sense of isolation, start enjoying social activities more, and even boost Work motivation.
growth_experiences: Growing up as an orphan since childhood, lacking family support and care. Feelings of Loneliness and despair began in childhood and intensified at important life events or milestones (like workplace gatherings, talking about family with others). The long experience of being without family makes him often feel like an outsider in Social situations, struggling to form deep connections; this experience continues to affect his adult intimate-relationship building and self-identity.

core_beliefs: I am destined to always be Loneliness, unable to have a family of my own
I do not have the ability to build meaningful relationships

special_situations.event: At work social activities, everyone discusses their families
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I have no family, it means I do not belong here and cannot be truly accepted
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Using Humor and hard Work to gain others' attention and approval, easing the feeling of being excluded
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I do not belong anywhere, I may always be alone

special_situations.event: Seeing others' intimate relationships and family interactions at Social gatherings or in public
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others are so intimate and I have not, it means I will never be able to have a family
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing self-exposure, avoiding topics, shifting to superficial interactions to reduce discomfort
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will definitely not have a family in the future

special_situations.event: Important life events or milestones (such as festivals, gatherings, talking about past growth) emphasize the family theme
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Because I have been an orphan since childhood, I will be Loneliness no matter what stage
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Displacing attention by doubling Work investment, proving one's worth
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I have always been Loneliness, and it will be so in the future

special_situations.event: Being asked about marriage or family status in social situations
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only having a family counts as success and acceptance; having no family equals failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Defusing awkwardness with self-deprecating Humor, avoiding deep discussion of intimacy needs
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Having no family means being a failure

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be loved and accepted steadily, to build her own intimate relationship and family
core_conflict.fear: Fearing rejection and being abandoned again, worrying that intimate relationships will expose one's shortcomings and lead to rejection
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of Being rejected by maintaining some emotional distance and superficial interaction
Using Humor and hard Work to gain external approval, compensating for inner deprivation and insecurity

object_relations.self_representation: An abandoned outsider, a Loneliness person hard to truly accept
object_relations.object_representation: Others/groups are insiders with intimate bonds, who may reject or not accept me

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When family topics appear in social situations or others' intimate interactions are seen
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Others having intimate families equals me being excluded, I am not accepted
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Self-deprecating or Displacing topics in a light, joking tone, avoiding deep expression of vulnerability and needs, maintaining superficially friendly interaction.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When feeling Loneliness and low self-worth (e.g., after holidays or milestone events)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: If not proving one's worth, will be ignored and rejected
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Channeling emotional energy into Work and task completion, buffering Loneliness and unease with achievements and recognition.

manifestations: Raised as an orphan, long lacking family support and love
Strongly feeling like an outsider at Social gatherings and family-themed events
Difficulty building deep connections; often feeling isolated
outcomes: Decreased work drive and affected self-care

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: Displacing with jokes or dismissive remarks when discussing family or intimacy topics
Avoiding directly expressing vulnerability and feelings of being needed

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Self-denial, believing one does not have the ability to build meaningful connections
Overly concerned with others' evaluations, cautious in relationships, reducing self-expression

positive_force: Has one close friend who can provide support in difficult times, showing the ability to build connections
Willing to proactively seek help and start counseling, positive attitude
Able to notice and clearly express negative beliefs and trigger situations
Having coping resources of using Humor and Work investment, with drive to act
negative_force: Orphan experience and long-term lack of family support leading to deep-rooted Loneliness and despair
Weak social support system, often feeling excluded
Catastrophizing, predicting the future, overgeneralization and all-or-nothing thinking and other cognitive distortions maintaining the problem
Self-denial, believing one does not have the ability to build deep relationships
Strongly triggering Loneliness and avoidance in family-themed scenes, leading to Social withdrawal

target_behavior.behavior: Significant Loneliness and despair arising in family-related social situations, accompanied by relationship avoidance and Self-denial
antecedent: Social gatherings or events emphasizing family topics
Holidays or important life milestone events
target_behavior.core_reason: Orphan upbringing and lack of family support formed the negative core belief 'I am destined to be Loneliness, unable to build relationships', maintained by catastrophizing, predicting the future, Overgeneralization and black-and-white thinking
target_behavior.function: Avoiding the risk of Being rejected and being abandoned again, protecting self-esteem and reducing discomfort
target_behavior.consequence: Social withdrawal, forming an outsider feeling; struggling to build deep connections; Loneliness intensifying

target_behavior.behavior: Insufficient motivation and declining self-care (e.g., daily routine and self-management affected)
antecedent: Long-term Loneliness and despair intensifying after socializing
Loneliness triggered at Work situations continues to affect daily life
target_behavior.core_reason: Negative beliefs about self and relationships trigger persistent helplessness and despair, lowering motivation and executive ability
target_behavior.function: Lowers emotional load and sense of failure in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Work performance affected, Decreased quality of life, further Reinforcing isolation and negative emotions
